en.用于客户端调用 API 的密钥: Key used by clients to call the API
en.支持 HTTP 和 SOCKS5 代理: HTTP and SOCKS5 proxies are supported
en.启用后，图片上传与图片/视频缓存下载可单独走该代理: When enabled, image uploads and cached image/video downloads can use this proxy separately
en.图片生成超时时间，范围：60-3600 秒（1分钟-1小时），超时后自动释放To: Image generation timeout: 60–3600 seconds (1 minute–1 hour). The token lock is released automatically on timeout.
en.视频生成超时时间，范围：60-7200 秒（1分钟-2小时），超时后返回上游AP: Video generation timeout: 60–7200 seconds (1 minute–2 hours). A timeout returns an upstream API timeout error.
en.生成、上传、轮询等请求失败时的最大重试次数，最小值为 1: Maximum retries for failed generation, upload, polling, and similar requests. Minimum: 1.
en.随机轮询使用默认负载优先策略；顺序轮询会按可用Token的稳定顺序依次使用，全部: Random rotation uses the default load-priority strategy. Sequential rotation uses available tokens in a stable order, starting a new round after all have been used.
en.Token 连续错误达到此次数后自动禁用: A token is disabled automatically after this many consecutive errors.
en.关闭后，生成的图片和视频将直接输出原始链接，不会缓存到本地: When disabled, generated images and videos return their original URLs and are not cached locally.
en.文件缓存超时时间，范围：0-86400 秒，其中 0 表示永不过期，不自动删除缓: Cache timeout: 0–86400 seconds. A value of 0 means files never expire and are not automatically deleted.

en.用于验证Chrome扩展插件的身份，留空将自动生成随机token: Used to authenticate the Chrome extension. Leave blank to generate a random token automatically.
en.当插件更新token时，如果该token被禁用，则自动启用它: If the extension updates a disabled token, enable it automatically.
en.安装最新版Chrome扩展后，将连接接口和Token配置到插件中，插件会自动提取: After installing the latest Chrome extension, configure the connection endpoint and token in the extension. It will extract Google Flow login cookies and update the system automatically.

en.为有头浏览器配置独立代理: Configure a dedicated proxy for the headed browser.
en.同时启动的浏览器实例数量，每个浏览器只开1个标签页，请求轮询分配: Number of browser instances to run simultaneously. Each browser opens one tab, and requests are distributed in rotation.
en.使用nodriver自动化浏览器获取验证码，支持标签页复用，性能更优: Uses a nodriver-controlled browser to solve captcha challenges, with reusable tabs for better performance.
en.personal 模式真实浏览器实例数。: Number of actual browser instances in personal mode.
en.有效槽位约等于 实例数 × 单实例标签页，上限 50。: Effective slots are approximately instances × tabs per instance, capped at 50.
en.只影响该 Token 可轮换的 project_id 数量，不决定打码标签页数。: Only controls how many project IDs this token can rotate through; it does not determine the number of captcha tabs.
en.打码标签页由全局共享池统一复用。: Captcha tabs are reused from a global shared pool.
en.每个浏览器最多保留多少个共享打码标签页。: Maximum number of shared captcha tabs retained per browser.
en.总并发槽位约为 浏览器实例数 × 这里，上限 50。: Total concurrent slots are approximately browser instances × this value, capped at 50.
en.成功获取多少个码后清理并重启浏览器。: Clean up and restart the browser after this many successful captcha solves.
en.高并发建议 0 或 >=50，5/10 会频繁重启导致排队。: For high concurrency, use 0 or >=50. Values such as 5 or 10 cause frequent restarts and queueing.
en.标签页空闲多久后自动回收，默认600秒(10分钟): How long an idle tab waits before cleanup. Default: 600 seconds (10 minutes).
en.为内置浏览器配置独立代理（优先级高于全局请求代理）: Configure a dedicated proxy for the built-in browser (higher priority than the global request proxy).
en.通过 HTTP 调用独立打码服务获取 token，并在请求结束后回调 finis: Call a separate captcha service over HTTP to obtain a token, then send a finish/error callback when the request ends.
en.开启后，详细的上游API请求和响应日志将写入: When enabled, detailed upstream API request and response logs are written to

en.仅覆盖当前 Token 的浏览器打码代理，留空则使用全局打码代理: Overrides the browser captcha proxy for this token only. Leave blank to use the global captcha proxy.
en.并发数量限制：设置同时处理的最大请求数。-1表示不限制: Concurrency limit: maximum simultaneous requests. -1 means unlimited.
